The packet prose said 5 contexts; there are six functions with sites, each legitimately needing its own ctx, and 6 is inside the budget of 8 (total 17 of ceiling 19). Pre-existing failures NOT mine, confirmed at base via cargo test --workspace --lib --tests: truck-meshalgo (2 lib tests incl. duplicate_edge_creates_no_second_cdt_edge, plus 7 tessellation integration tests incl. solid_is_closed and csolid_is_closed), truck-shapeops (healing::tests::step_import and fillet complex_surface), truck-stepio (lib in::step_geometry::geom_impls::builder and input assy/table/geometry/tessellate_shape tests). One-sided surprise: rustfmt moved the trailing // BG-TOL-001: comment off lines ending in '{' onto the following line (edge.rs x2, geom_impls.rs, geometry.rs), exactly as the packet warned; the marker still sits on the immediately following line. Also worth noting the one-sided vs symmetric distinction is real: replacing t < t0 + ctx.ratio_margin() with is_small_ratio(t - t0) would be wrong, and the new test pins that. Cargo.toml check: neither truck-topology nor truck-modeling sets autotests = false, so the new tests/tolerance_migration.rs is picked up automatically, as the packet predicted.
